The '''Thisspias system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Farstey sector/Legends|Farstey sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thisspias/Legends|Thisspias]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Thisspiasian/Legends|Thisspiasians]].
